This is the fourth application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nargik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS, 2023) by applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 672/2023, registered at Police Station Rahatgarh, District Sagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 409,
420, 417, 418, 120-B, 467 and 201 of IPC.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that earlier bail application filed by applicant was dismissed on merits, but liberty was granted to file repeat application if trial could not be completed within a period of 30 days.
It is submitted that applicant is in jail since 25.10.2023.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge- sheet has already been filed.
Applicant is an under trial prisoner and he NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1005 2 MCRC-54443-2024 may not be kept in jail for indefinitely long period of time.

In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the State as well as counsel appearing for the objector opposed the bail application.
It is submitted by them that offence registered against the applicant are serious in nature.
Conduct of applicant is to delay the trial himself.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Applicant is in jail for a long period of time.
Earlier application was dismissed with liberty to file repeat application after a period of 30 days if trial could not be completed.
Status report has been obtained.
In status report, it has been mentioned that trial Judge has been transferred to District Sidhi as Special Judge.
Matter was placed before another Judge.
On said date, prosecution witnesses were present, but they could not examined.
Mutual allegation is being made by applicant as well as by the prosecution.
It is submitted by counsel for the applicant that due to political vendetta,
prosecution
is also acting interestingly in the case

. Offences registered against the applicant are under Sections 420, 409, 417, 418, 120-B, 467 of Indian Penal Code, which relates to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1005 3 MCRC-54443-2024 embezzlement of Government land.

6. Taking into account, period of incarceration of the applicant and nature of offences alleged to have been committed by the applicant, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on following conditions :
(i) Applicant will mark his presence before local police station twice every month (on 1st and 15th day) till completion of trial.

(ii) It is made clear that if applicant violates the terms and conditions of the bail order or he tries to influence the witnesses or tamper with evidence, prosecution is at liberty to file application for cancellation of bail.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the Court concerned on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.
